I found **33 papers** in the library that report AlpacaEval win rates for their own model or method. I searched every paper for "AlpacaEval" (67 files) and for other spellings, then read the context of each match. The pages below come from the section headings in the markdown. Where I name a version, the paper states it next to the result; I did not check the version for the others.

**Model reports (scores for the authors' own models)**
- **OLMo**: OLMo-7B before and after adaptation, [p. 7, Table 4](http://pdf.invalid/llm/foundation-models/OLMo.%20Accelerating%20the%20Science%20of%20Language%20Models.pdf?dest=table.4&page=7); full table on p. 20 (App. E).
- **OLMo 2**: OLMo 2 Instruct, AlpacaEval 2 LC, [p. 10, Table 7](http://pdf.invalid/llm/foundation-models/2%20OLMo%202%20Furious.pdf?dest=table.7&page=10); scores after each training stage on p. 26, Table 16.
- **Olmo 3**: AlpacaEval 2 LC, [p. 5](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/fine-tuning/Olmo%203.pdf?page=5) and the main results on p. 37; curves during RL training on p. 49 (Figs. 19–20).
- **Tülu 3**: AlpacaEval 2 LC, [p. 5](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/fine-tuning/Tulu%203.%20Pushing%20Frontiers%20in%20Open%20Language%20Model%20Post-Training.pdf?page=5), p. 8 and p. 35; data ablations on p. 23 (Fig. 8).
- **DeepSeek-V2**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 18, Table 4](http://pdf.invalid/llm/foundation-models/DeepSeek-V2.%20A%20Strong,%20Economical,%20and%20Efficient%20Mixture-of-Experts%20Language%20Model.pdf?dest=table.4&page=18).
- **DeepSeek-V3**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 32, Table 7](http://pdf.invalid/llm/foundation-models/DeepSeek-V3%20Technical%20Report.pdf?dest=table.7&page=32); discussed on p. 33.
- **DeepSeek-R1**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 8, Table 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/rl-for-reasoning/DeepSeek-R1.%20Incentivizing%20Reasoning%20Capability%20in%20LLMs%20via%20Reinforcement%20Learning.pdf?dest=table.3&page=8) (by training stage); also p. 41 and p. 54.
- **Nemotron-4 340B**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 13](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/Nemotron-4%20340B%20Technical%20Report.pdf?page=13).
- **DataComp-LM**: DCLM-baseline after instruction tuning, AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 71, Table 26](http://pdf.invalid/llm/pretraining/DataComp-LM.%20In%20search%20of%20the%20next%20generation%20of%20training%20sets%20for%20language%20models.pdf?dest=table.26&page=71); mentioned on p. 10.
- **GritLM**: AlpacaEval 1.0 (p. 33), [p. 6, Table 2](http://pdf.invalid/representation-learning/embeddings/Generative%20Representational%20Instruction%20Tuning.pdf?dest=table.2&page=6); alignment results on p. 7, ablations on p. 8.

**Preference optimisation and RLHF methods**
- **Self-Rewarding LMs**: AlpacaEval 2.0, [p. 6, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/Self-Rewarding%20Language%20Models.pdf?dest=table.1&page=6).
- **KTO**: AlpacaEval LC, [p. 5](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/KTO.%20Model%20Alignment%20as%20Prospect%20Theoretic%20Optimization.pdf?page=5); AlpacaEval 2 on p. 17 (Fig. 6, Table 5).
- **ORPO**: AlpacaEval 1.0 and 2.0, [p. 5, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/ORPO.%20Monolithic%20Preference%20Optimization%20without%20Reference%20Model.pdf?dest=table.1&page=5); also p. 1, Fig. 1.
- **SimPO**: AlpacaEval 2 LC and raw win rate, [p. 1, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/SimPO.%20Simple%20Preference%20Optimization%20with%20a%20Reference-Free%20Reward.pdf?dest=table.1&page=1); main results on p. 6.
- **RLHF Workflow**: LC AlpacaEval-2, [p. 12, Table 2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/RLHF%20Workflow.%20From%20Reward%20Modeling%20to%20Online%20RLHF.pdf?dest=table.2&page=12); length-penalty variant on p. 13, Table 4.
- **Unpacking DPO and PPO**: AlpacaEval 2 win rate of PPO policies trained with each reward model, [p. 6, Table 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/preference-learning/Unpacking%20DPO%20and%20PPO.%20Disentangling%20Best%20Practices%20for%20Learning%20from%20Preference%20Feedback.pdf?dest=table.3&page=6).
- **Thinking LLMs (TPO)**: AlpacaEval 2 LC, [p. 5, Tables 1–2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/reasoning/Thinking%20LLMs.%20General%20Instruction%20Following%20with%20Thought%20Generation.pdf?dest=table.1&page=5); also p. 7, Table 3.
- **Checklists (RLCF)**: AlpacaEval, original and length-controlled, [p. 5, Table 4](http://pdf.invalid/llm/evaluation/methods/Checklists%20Are%20Better%20Than%20Reward%20Models%20For%20Aligning%20Language%20Models.pdf?dest=table.4&page=5).
- **Generalizing Verifiable IF**: "Alpaca" column for their RLVR models, [p. 6, Table 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/evaluation/benchmarks/Generalizing%20Verifiable%20Instruction%20Following.pdf?dest=table.3&page=6); AlpacaEval 2 of 31.6 for the variant that resists reward hacking on p. 19.
- **Mixture-of-Agents**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 5](http://pdf.invalid/llm/agents/Mixture-of-Agents%20Enhances%20Large%20Language%20Model%20Capabilities.pdf?dest=subsection.3.2&page=5); also p. 1, Fig. 1.

**Data papers (models trained on the authors' own data)**
- **WizardLM**: [p. 7](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/WizardLM.%20Empowering%20large%20pre-trained%20language%20models%20to%20follow%20complex%20instructions.pdf?page=7); ablations on p. 8, checkpoints on p. 21.
- **Self-Alignment with Instruction Backtranslation (Humpback)**: win rate against text-davinci-003, [p. 6](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/Self-Alignment%20with%20Instruction%20Backtranslation.pdf?page=6).
- **UltraFeedback**: UltraLM against text-davinci-003, Table 3 (the markdown places it after the §3.1 heading on p. 4; the results are discussed on [p. 6](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/UltraFeedback.%20Boosting%20Language%20Models%20with%20Scaled%20AI%20Feedback.pdf?dest=table.3&page=6)); best-of-n results on p. 5, Fig. 2.
- **HelpSteer2**: AlpacaEval 2.0 LC, [p. 10](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/HelpSteer2.%20Open-source%20dataset%20for%20training%20top-performing%20reward%20models.pdf?page=10).
- **Magpie**: AlpacaEval 2 LC and raw win rate, [p. 7–8, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/Magpie.%20Alignment%20Data%20Synthesis%20from%20Scratch%20by%20Prompting%20Aligned%20LLMs%20with%20Nothing.pdf?dest=table.1&page=8); Magpie-MT on p. 24.
- **AgentInstruct (Orca-3)**: [p. 15](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/AgentInstruct.%20Toward%20Generative%20Teaching%20with%20Agentic%20Flows.pdf?page=15); setup on p. 27.
- **WildFeedback**: AlpacaEval 2 LC and raw win rate, [p. 8, Table 3](http://pdf.invalid/llm/post-training/data/WildFeedback.%20Aligning%20LLMs%20With%20In-situ%20User%20Interactions%20And%20Feedback.pdf?dest=table.3&page=8).

**Safety, privacy and evaluation studies with their own trained or constructed models**
- **Safety Alignment Should Be More Than a Few Tokens Deep**: AlpacaEval 1.0 win rate of their augmented fine-tuned Llama-2-7B-Chat, [p. 6](http://pdf.invalid/llm/safety-and-privacy/Safety%20Alignment%20Should%20Be%20Made%20More%20Than%20Just%20a%20Few%20Tokens%20Deep.pdf?dest=subsection.3.1&page=6); details on p. 16.
- **Privacy-Preserving Instructions**: models fine-tuned on their privacy-preserving (differentially private) instructions, [p. 23, Table 8](http://pdf.invalid/llm/safety-and-privacy/Privacy-Preserving%20Instructions%20for%20Aligning%20Large%20Language%20Models.pdf?dest=table.8&page=23).
- **Cheating Automatic LLM Benchmarks**: their null model reaches 86.5% LC on AlpacaEval 2.0, [p. 5, Table 2](http://pdf.invalid/llm/evaluation/methods/Cheating%20Automatic%20LLM%20Benchmarks.%20Null%20Models%20Achieve%20High%20Win%20Rates.pdf?dest=table.2&page=5); also p. 1.
- **Preference Leakage**: AlpacaEval 2.0 results for the student models they trained, [p. 4–5, Table 1](http://pdf.invalid/llm/evaluation/methods/Preference%20Leakage.%20A%20Contamination%20Problem%20in%20LLM-as-a-judge.pdf?dest=table.1&page=5); more on p. 7.

**Left out:** these papers mention AlpacaEval but do not report a win rate for a model of their own on it:
- **Length-Controlled AlpacaEval** defines the metric itself.
- **Spec Learning** uses the length-controlled method on its own tasks (p. 17, Table 8).
- **Qwen2.5-Omni** reports a spoken version of AlpacaEval (VoiceBench), which is scored rather than a win rate (p. 8).
- **FollowBench** lists other labs' models (p. 8, Table 4).
- **URIAL (The Unlocking Spell)** uses AlpacaEval prompts but its own multi-aspect scoring (p. 7).
- **RewardBench, Inverse Constitutional AI, Trust or Escalate, tinyBenchmarks and Arena-Hard** use AlpacaEval data or leaderboards as material.
- The rest are surveys or only cite it.

This list rests on searching the text and reading the surrounding passages; I did not check the numbers against the PDFs. I changed no files, so there is nothing to commit.
